overview_description.description:
Jumy is a NFT marketplace focused on curated digital art collections and brand collaborations. The platform connects artists, creators, celebrities, and premium brands with collectors through exclusive NFT drops and digital experiences.

The company positions itself as one of the first curated NFT marketplaces in the Middle East, offering services beyond NFT trading, including Web3 consulting and brand advisory solutions. Jumy supports both cryptocurrency and fiat payments, helping make NFT collecting more accessible to regional users and newcomers to blockchain technology.
